turns.query: For 2018-01-01 through 2022-12-31, align the value-weighted HiTec portfolio with the daily factor table by date. Run OLS with HiTec minus RF as the dependent variable and an intercept, Mkt-RF, SMB and HML as regressors, all in the table's percentage units. Report the observation count, daily alpha, three factor coefficients, ordinary in-sample R-squared, and alpha annualized as (1 + daily alpha/100)^252 - 1. Interpret the coefficients and state what this regression does not establish.
